mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) as totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE attend_date = #{date} AND status = 1) as attendCount

SELECT a.attend_date as attendDate, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 END) as attendCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) as totalStudents FROM attendance a WHERE a.attend_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY a.attend_date ORDER BY a.attend_date
